channel.title: The Drill Down: Baltimore Ravens
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 11: Ravens at Panthers
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: CAR -2.5 · O/U 43.5 | Model CAR 53% vs. market 55% | Baltimore has to create chunk plays at an 8.3% clip, near the bottom of the league, against a Carolina defense that concedes explosives on just 7.6% of snaps. Tetairoa McMillan absorbs 25% of Carolina's targets and 33% of its air yards, and he faces a Baltimore pass defense that ranks in the bottom half. Our model makes Carolina 53%, below the market's 55%, with home field doing most of the work.

item.title: Week 10: Chargers at Ravens
item.description: Mon 11/16 · 8:15 PM ET | Line: BAL -4.5 · O/U 38.5 | Model BAL 88% vs. market 66% | The Chargers must generate chunk plays, a skill that ranks 29th in the league, against a Baltimore defense that allows explosives at the fifth-lowest rate. Mark Andrews has given back 2.0 yards after the catch versus expected, and the Chargers allow the 18th-most yards after catch over expected. Our model has Baltimore at 88 percent against a market price of 66, with the rushing matchup and the starting quarterback driving most of the gap.
